A suitable prespecified ablation would reuse one frozen SASRec checkpoint per dataset: measure training-item ranks, then delete equal numbers of diagnostic-selected, random, oldest, or newest history events at inference. Keep deletion fraction, sequence reconstruction, users, and candidates fixed. These probes measure model sensitivity, not causal user preferences; training ranks alone can reflect memorization. Compare against training-only item counts and timestamp-decayed popularity. Popularity’s temporal definition matters ([baseline study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.13829)). To test whether diagnostics justify their cost, prespecify the decisions each diagnostic would trigger and compare resulting validation gains per total GPU-second against simple heuristics or ordinary tuning, charging diagnostics, retraining, and failures within 43,200 seconds. Frozen probes alone cannot establish improved training decisions.

For each comparison, retain paired user differences d = hit_variant − hit_baseline, report gains/losses and mean differences within each dataset, then average the four dataset differences equally. Bootstrap paired users within datasets for a macro-average confidence interval; exact McNemar tests assess dataset-level discordant hits. User-based paired comparisons align with established [offline evaluation guidance](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10791-020-09371-3). Prespecify primary contrasts and apply Holm correction across that family. This does not repair adaptive checkpoint or model selection: intervals computed after choosing winners on the same validation users remain exploratory; independent confirmation is needed ([adaptive holdout research](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2015/hash/bad5f33780c42f2588878a9d07405083-Abstract.html)).

Seed 42 alone supports conclusions conditional on that training run. User bootstrapping cannot estimate training-seed uncertainty. If additional seeds are permitted, reserve budget for matched baseline–variant reruns and resample seed pairs and users separately; otherwise state that limitation explicitly. Few-run uncertainty can materially change benchmark conclusions ([multi-run evaluation study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.13264)).
